exposure: information pamphlet about pain management options in labor and fetal development during pregnancy (control)
cohort: The study included 68 primigravid women with a gestational age of 24-28 weeks and a Fear of Childbirth score above 65, referred to health centers in Tabriz, Iran.
finding: The haptonomy intervention significantly reduced Fear of Childbirth and increased Maternal-Fetal Attachment among primigravid women.
cross-section timing: Baseline measurements were taken at 24-28 weeks gestation, and post-intervention measurements were taken at 35-37 weeks gestation.
